descriptions.d24i_grid_scan_reverse_8010ca34: Variant of the grid cell scan 0x8010c494 walking rows downward from 6 for each column: for each cell passing edge test 0x8010bd74, seek the run-length cursor at +28 to (layer << 10) + row + (column << 5), read the run value and draw two triangles (0x8010b318) from corners +1370, +74, +1298 with flag 0 and +74, +1298, +2 with flag 1.
